case_name: Smt. Sunanda Gon Choudhury vs The Child Welfare Committee

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Sunanda Gon Choudhury, D/O: Sri Narayan Gon Choudhury
parties.respondent_defendant: The Child Welfare Committee, Represented by its Chair Person, Dhalai District, Jawaharnagar, P.O & P.S: Ambassa, Dist: Dhalai, PIN: 799289

facts_of_case: Petitioner was married to Sri Narayan Singha according to Hindu rites and customs. Owing to marital discord, the petitioner instituted a divorce suit being T.S. (Div) No. 214 of 2022 before the learned Family Court, West Tripura, Agartala, which was allowed, and the marriage between the parties was dissolved by judgment and decree dated 18.07.2024.

legal_principles.principle: A trial must be held in accordance with the procedure established by law before convicting an individual.
legal_principles.held: The impugned order convicting the petitioner guilty of the offence under Section 75 of the Act of 2015 is, on the face of the record, an unsustainable order, having been passed by an authority lacking subject-matter jurisdiction and also for not holding any trial in accordance with the procedure established by law.
applicable_acts_sections: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 — Section 86

legal_principles.principle: An authority lacking subject-matter jurisdiction cannot pass a sustainable order.
legal_principles.held: The impugned order passed by the Child Welfare Committee is, on the face of the record, an unsustainable order, having been passed by an authority lacking subject-matter jurisdiction.
applicable_acts_sections: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015

outcome.final_order: By decision dated 13.09.2024, the Child Welfare Committee, Dhalai District, Ambassa, upon considering the relevant reports, declared Master Kumit Gour, aged about 10 years, to be a child in need of care and protection and placed him in foster care with the petitioner for a period of one year.

use_for_drafting: responding to Child Welfare Committee orders
